name: ST Chat5pt
description: Telegram news summaries using Flask, MongoDB Atlas, OpenAI, and Heroku Scheduler.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Telegram bot token from BotFather.

MONGODB_URI.description: Your MongoDB Atlas connection string, with access to the article and user databases.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key for generating article summaries.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: This app's HTTPS origin from Heroku app settings, including its generated domain suffix.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Secret used to authenticate Telegram webhook deliveries.

ADMIN_USER_IDS.description: Optional comma-separated Telegram user IDs allowed to view subscriber counts.
